puzzles.title: The Unbalanced Archive Lock
puzzles.prompt:
Etched into the iron door of the Restricted Vault is an auditor's riddle:

'I weigh the beggar and the sovereign alike, yet hold no gold of my own. Break my beam and the city goes dark; tip my pans and a soul is bought. What am I?'
puzzles.question: Name the emblem carved into the vault dial.
puzzles.hint: Every coin, decree, and banner of the Chancery bears this twin-panned instrument.

successOutcome.text: The brass tumblers align with a solemn chime! The Restricted Vault opens, revealing the High Auditor's cipher-roll.

puzzles.title: Enigma of the Thirteenth Chime
puzzles.prompt:
Twelve bronze hammers strike the hours of labor, yet a thirteenth silent hammer hangs bound in black silk above an inscription:

'Twelve tolls belong to the Ledger; the thirteenth belongs to what no tax can collect and every weary soul seeks.'
puzzles.question: Speak the word that frees the thirteenth hammer.
puzzles.hint: The Order of the Last Bell preaches that death was meant to end in true rest.

successOutcome.text: The silent hammer falls once with a deep resonance that shivers through the tower, revealing a hidden Syndicate dispatch!

puzzles.title: Cipher of the Unstamped Scriptorium
puzzles.prompt:
A wax-cylinder plinth asks in archaic script:

'Before coins were struck from bone and smoke was sold by weight, what wooden instrument carried every traveler across the dark water without asking their name?'
puzzles.question: Identify the older emblem of the crossing.
puzzles.hint: The Oar-Keepers' Union at Weir-Port still swears by this simple river tool.

successOutcome.text: The plinth slides aside, uncovering the First Seal Fragment of Passage!

puzzles.title: Inscription of the First Scale
puzzles.prompt:
At the threshold of the First Seal Chamber, two pans hover empty over the abyss:

'Fuel burns until only cinder remains; empires tax until only ghosts remain. What survives when both flame and ledger turn to dust?'
puzzles.question: Answer the threshold's final question.
puzzles.hint: The Mnemonic Collegium guards what outlives every mortal body.

successOutcome.text: The silver chains slacken with a ringing sigh, opening the way into the Chamber of the First Seal!
